youtube.titel: Australia Sent Machine Guns To Fight Birds #history
youtube.beschreibung:
In 1932, about 20,000 emus were damaging wheat farms in Western Australia. Soldiers with machine guns were sent in, but the birds split into small groups and were hard to hit. After a gun jammed and a few weeks passed, the army withdrew.

Sources: Wikipedia; Australian Geographic; Discover Wildlife.
